Concept Description: Whether the participant is known to have died by the end of the study's follow-up. BDC-HM slots: Person.vital_status (VitalStatusEnum: ALIVE, DEAD) and Person.age_at_death (integer days). Use for a death indicator or for the existence of a death record. Not for a cause-specific death flag (e.g. CHD death): that is Cause of death, and may also be a Condition with condition_provenance DEATH_RECORD. The CURIE is the V1 reference code (OMOP 'Death', verified in Athena); BDC-HM emits no concept code for Person, the slot carries the meaning.

The underlying cause of death (the disease or injury that started the train of events leading to death) and any contributing causes, from a death certificate or study adjudication. BDC-HM slot: Person.cause_of_death, a list of CauseOfDeath objects, each with cause (ICD-10-CM code) and order (1 = underlying or primary). Use for ICD-coded death certificate causes and for adjudicated cause-of-death categories. Not for the fact of death alone (that is Death). The CURIE is the V1 reference code (OMOP 'Cause of death', verified in Athena); it is not emitted.
